metadata.title: Symmetric Noir Portrait with Overlapping Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A mirrored high-contrast portrait layout featuring a central typographic anchor and overlapping text layers in a cool-toned noir style.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, symmetrical composition where two identical high-contrast portraits face each other across a central black void, anchored by a large circular graphic element and layered, wide-tracked typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between left and right portrait elements
Contrast between deep black negative space and pale blue highlights
Hierarchy established by the oversized central 'O' character
Visual tension created by overlapping text layers at top and bottom
coreInvariants: Desaturated cool-blue and white color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two mirrored portraits occupy the left and right thirds of the frame, facing inward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, thick-stroked circular character centered in the upper third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central circle, moves outward to the mirrored faces, and then to the horizontal text bands at the top and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of pure black negative space in the center and corners to isolate subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for extreme contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale, icy blue for highlights on skin and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for primary typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value range from 0 to 100.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Central 'O' is scaled significantly larger than surrounding text to act as a graphic icon.

composition.relationshipToImage: overlaid on subjects and negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying scale and layering for depth.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows to create separation between text layers

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp terminals.
Provides the wide geometric structure and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, mirrored noir portrait of a man in profile facing inward. Use deep black shadows and pale blue highlights. Leave a wide black void in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large white geometric 'O' in the top center. Overlay horizontal bands of wide-tracked white sans-serif text at the top and bottom, using a second offset layer of the same text in a darker tone to create a ghosted effect.

verificationChecks: Is the typography wide-tracked and geometric?
Is the color palette limited to black, icy blue, and white?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the central graphic element
Amount of overlap in the ghosted text layers
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Verify text legibility against high-contrast areas
Ensure the blue tint is consistent across both portraits
Confirm the central graphic is perfectly centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Mirrored [Subject] + Chiaroscuro Lighting + [Cool Tone] Tint + Geometric Sans-Serif Overlays
